items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: my next door neighbor, his name was Big Eyed Lut. Mm-hmm. And, uh, I used to admire his style

ctx.x: And you heard the bands, didn't you? Oh, yeah, I heard a lot of them. Did you have any neighbors who played music that you used to listen to?

Well, my next door neighbor, his name was Big Eyed Lut. Mm-hmm. And, uh, I used to admire his style, but I was only about eight or nine years old. Yeah. And I still remember him. And around 15 years old, uh, I asked the old man to buy McLaren and he said, nope. So I had to beg for about two or three weeks. Finally, he got me a little cheap one for about thirty dollars. Mm-hmm. And I started to take lessons. I had, uh, started going to the Italian Hall there. Mm-hmm. And, uh, they had some old professor there. Uh,…
